Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the sales and use tax exemption for livestock nutrient management equipment and facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the sales and use tax exemption for livestocknutrient management equipment and facilities; and amending RCW82.08.890 and 82.12.890.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.08.890 and 2006 c 151 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales toeligible persons of: (a) Services rendered in respect to operating,repairing, cleaning, altering, or improving of livestock nutrientmanagement ((equipment and)) facilities((,)); (b) services rendered inrespect to operating, repairing, cleaning, altering, or improving oflivestock nutrient management equipment; (c) livestock nutrientmanagement equipment, including repair or replacement parts; or ((tosales of)) (d) tangible personal property that becomes an ingredient orcomponent of ((the equipment and)) livestock nutrient managementfacilities, including repair or replacement parts. (2)(a) To be eligible, the equipment and facilities must be used((exclusively)) at least ninety percent of the time for activitiesnecessary to maintain a livestock nutrient management plan. p. 1 HB 2278 (b) The exemption applies to sales made after the livestocknutrient management plan is: (i) Certified under chapter 90.64 RCW;(ii) approved as part of the permit issued under chapter 90.48 RCW; or(iii) approved as required under subsection (4)(c)(iii) of thissection. (3)(a) The department of revenue must provide an exemptioncertificate to an eligible person upon application by that person. Thedepartment of agriculture must provide a list of eligible persons, asdefined in subsection (4)(c)(i) and (ii) of this section, to thedepartment of revenue. Conservation districts must maintain lists ofeligible persons as defined in subsection (4)(c)(iii) of this sectionto allow the department of revenue to verify eligibility. Theapplication must be in a form and manner prescribed by the departmentand must contain information regarding the location of the dairy oranimal feeding operation and other information the department mayrequire. (b) A person claiming an exemption under this section must keeprecords necessary for the department to verify eligibility under thissection. The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (4) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section andRCW 82.12.890 unless the context clearly requires otherwise: (a) "Animal feeding operation" means a lot or facility, other thanan aquatic animal production facility, where the following conditionsare met: (i) Animals, other than aquatic animals, have been, are, or will bestabled or confined and fed or maintained for a total of fortyfivedays or more in any twelvemonth period; and (ii) Crops, vegetation, forage growth, or postharvest residues arenot sustained in the normal growing season over any portion of the lotor facility. (b) "Conservation district" means a subdivision of state governmentorganized under chapter 89.08 RCW. (c) "Eligible person" means a person (i) licensed to produce milkunder chapter 15.36 RCW who has a certified dairy nutrient managementplan, as required by chapter 90.64 RCW; (ii) who owns an animal feeding HB 2278 p. 2 operation and has a permit issued under chapter 90.48 RCW; or (iii) whoowns an animal feeding operation and has a nutrient management planapproved by a conservation district as meeting natural resourceconservation service field office technical guide standards. (d) "Livestock nutrient management ((equipment and)) facilities"means ((machinery, equipment, and)) structures used in the handling andtreatment of livestock manure, such as ((aerators, agitators, alleyscrapers, augers,)) dams, ((gutter cleaners, loaders,)) lagoons,((pipes, pumps, separators,)) storage sheds, and tanks. The term alsoincludes tangible personal property that becomes an ingredient orcomponent of the ((equipment and)) facilities, ((including)) such asaerators, agitators, pipes, pumps, and separators, and includes repairand replacement parts. (e) "Livestock nutrient management equipment" means tangiblepersonal property used in the handling or treatment of livestock manuresuch as alley scrapers, augers, gutter cleaners, tractors, and loaders. (f) "Permit" means either a state waste discharge permit or anational pollutant discharge elimination system permit, or both.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.12.890 and 2006 c 151 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse by an eligible person of ((tangible personal property that becomesan ingredient or component of livestock nutrient management equipmentand facilities, as defined in RCW 82.08.890, or to labor and servicesrendered in respect to repairing, cleaning, altering, or improvingeligible tangible personal property)): (a) Services rendered inrespect to operating, repairing, cleaning, altering, or improving oflivestock nutrient management facilities; (b) services rendered inrespect to operating, repairing, cleaning, altering, or improving oflivestock nutrient management equipment; (c) livestock nutrientmanagement equipment, including repair or replacement parts; or (d)tangible personal property that becomes an ingredient or component oflivestock nutrient management facilities, including repair orreplacement parts. (2)(a) To be eligible, the equipment and facilities must be used((exclusively)) at least ninety percent of the time for activitiesnecessary to maintain a livestock nutrient management plan. p. 3 HB 2278 (b) The exemption applies to the use of tangible personal propertyor labor and services made after the livestock nutrient management planis: (i) Certified under chapter 90.64 RCW; (ii) approved as part ofthe permit issued under chapter 90.48 RCW; or (iii) approved asrequired under RCW 82.08.890(4)(c)(iii). (3) The exemption certificate and recordkeeping requirements of RCW82.08.890 apply to this section. The definitions in RCW 82.08.890apply to this section.
